scenes.script:
Miss Nova says: Hello, what is your name?
Rahul says: My name is Rahul.
Miss Nova says: How old are you?
Rahul says: I have 22.
Miss Nova says: Not 'I have 22', ye 'I am 22 years old' hona chahiye.
Rahul says: Okay, I am 22 years old.
Miss Nova says: Where are you from?
Rahul says: I am Uttar Pradesh.
Miss Nova says: Not 'I am Uttar Pradesh', ye 'I am from Uttar Pradesh' hota hai.
Rahul says: Oh, okay. Jab bhi English bolna hota hai, main hamesha freeze ho jata hoon.
Miss Nova says: Ye bilkul normal hai. Main hoon Miss Nova. Main aapko Supernova AI par English bolna sikhati hoon, aur saari logic aapki apni language Hindi mein explain karti hoon.
Rahul says: Par kya log meri mistakes par hansenge nahi?
Miss Nova says: Yahan bilkul nahi. Aap chahe 1000 mistakes karein, main aapko bina judge kiye correct karungi.

parsed.self_critique_fixed: The script has been translated into natural, code-mixed, and romanized Hindi. The taught lines are kept in verbatim English as per T2a. Miss Nova uses the polite 'aap' register while Rahul and Priya use casual-respectful tones. The language self-reference has been successfully localized to 'Hindi' in Scene 1. The multiplier '7x cheaper' has been translated to '7 guna sasta' following the Hindi module rules. No brand-safety violations or unresolved comments were present.

violations.why: Showing an active installation progress or 'Installing...' text mimics a system/app store download action, which is a prohibited fake UI/misleading mechanic under Meta's ad policies.
violations.fix: Remove the 'Installing...' text and the visual of the app installing, replacing it with a static app store page or a simple 'Download Now' button.

safety.summary: The ad is highly compliant except for a Meta policy violation in Scene 3 where an active installation progress and 'Installing...' text mimic a fake system/UI mechanic.
